story_text: As a user, I want to receive an error when my password is shorter than 8 characters so that I use a secure password.

positive.title: Display error message when password is shorter than 8 characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an email address in the email field.
4. Enter a password that is shorter than 8 characters in the password field.
5. Click the 'Register' button.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is too short.

positive.title: Prevent registration with password shorter than 8 characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an email address in the email field.
4. Enter a password that is shorter than 8 characters in the password field.
5. Click the 'Register' button.
positive.expected_result: User is prevented from registering with a password that is shorter than 8 characters.

positive.title: Remove error message after correcting password to valid length
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an email address in the email field.
4. Enter a password that is shorter than 8 characters in the password field.
5. Click the 'Register' button.
6. After receiving the error message, enter a password that is 8 characters or longer in the password field.
7. Click the 'Register' button again.
positive.expected_result: User is able to register with a valid password.

negative.title: Register with empty password field
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an email address in the email field.
4. Leave the password field empty.
5. Click the 'Register' button.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password field is required.

edge.title: Register with password at maximum length boundary (e.g., 7 characters)
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an email address in the email field.
4. Enter a password that is exactly 7 characters long in the password field.
5. Click the 'Register' button.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is too short.
